$comment: Declarative registry of MCP capabilities served via the untool tunnel for BOTH cloud and local Claudes. Add a server entry + run `node tools/mcp-serve.mjs reconcile` to make a new capability live: it ensures the tunnel ingress path, a persistent AgentArmy-* logon task, and emits the .mcp.json block. Reuses the existing mcp.untool.ai CF Access app + service tokens — never a new subdomain/app. See memory feedback_serve_capabilities_via_mcp.

servers.name: local-fleet
servers.description: untool docker/build control plane (fleet_ps/inspect/logs/up/down/restart/build/deploy) — the host default route + /healthz.
